name: phone-harness
tagline: Let your agent control your phone
description: phone-harness is a harness that lets your AI agent control your phone. It bridges agent tooling to mobile devices, enabling automation of real phone workflows — tapping, typing, reading screens — the same way computer-use agents control desktops. The project targets the growing interest in mobile agent control and ships as a Python harness.
highlights: Agent-driven control of real phones, not just emulators
Python harness that slots into agent workflows
1.1k stars in days reflects intense interest in mobile agent control
curatorNote: Computer-use agents conquered the desktop; the phone is the obvious next frontier. phone-harness is one of the first credible open takes on letting agents drive real devices.
